summary.text: R.J. Kost is a Republican candidate for the Wyoming State Senate, District 19, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and previously represented the district from 2019 to 2023.
He advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: R.J. Kost assumed office in the Wyoming State Senate on January 7, 2019, succeeding Ray Peterson, and left office on January 2, 2023, when Dan Laursen succeeded him.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance records list a 2018 general election win and a 2022 primary loss for Senate District 19.
